title: Ruling on Settlement Timing for Northgate Special Order Restocking
content:
This ruling fixes how the timing of a return affects the settlement restocking fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns charges on a changed-mind return of Northgate Special Order merchandise for a consumer-segment membership.

## Ruling

Settlement timing: when the return authorization was requested no more than 7 calendar days after the purchase's fulfillment date, the fee is taken at 0.5 of its amount; when it was requested 8 to 14 calendar days after, at 0.75 of its amount; otherwise at its full amount (1). Days are counted as calendar days, the fulfillment date being day 0.

The request date is the requested date of the most recently requested received return authorization on the purchase; the fulfillment date is the one recorded on the purchase. The multiplier applies to the amount the rate yields on the changed-mind refund, before that amount is rounded half up to the cent.

| Days from the fulfillment date to the request | Share of the fee taken |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | 0.5 |
| 8 to 14 | 0.75 |
| 15 or more | 1 (full amount) |

## Calendar boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Fulfillment date (day 0) | Requested | Day | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 September | 27 September | 7 | 0.5 |
| 20 September | 28 September | 8 | 0.75 |
| 20 September | 4 October | 14 | 0.75 |
| 20 September | 5 October | 15 | 1 |

Hypothetical amount: a rate amount of 113.68 taken at 0.75 is 85.26; at 0.5 it is 56.84. An amount of 101.01 at 0.75 gives 75.7575, rounded half up to 75.76.
